result.summary: Several layout and content issues: truncated restaurant names, a likely duplicate listing, a cut-off category chip, and a promo card that clips at the bottom.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in Fastest near you is truncated (“Smash Bros Bu”), so the full name is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow the name to wrap to two lines, use a smaller type size, or show an ellipsis with a tooltip/full name on tap.

issues.description: Green Bowl Poké appears twice in a row with the same image, time, and delivery fee, which looks like a data or list-duplication bug.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate restaurant cards and verify the nearby/fastest feed is not repeating the same venue.

issues.description: The last category chip is clipped at the right edge of the screen, so users cannot see the full label.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding or a fade/peek so the last chip is fully visible, or make the row clearly scrollable with enough inset.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant promo card is cut off by the tab bar, hiding the name and details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset so cards sit fully above the navigation bar, or make the last card peek intentionally with enough visible context.
